title: The FSA Mindset & Six-Step Framework
core_question: Who is reading the financial statements, and what specific decision question are they trying to answer?

framework.desc: Identify industry profit drivers, competitive advantages (Cost Leadership vs Differentiation), and key risks.
Evaluate accounting flexibility, red flags, distortions, and restate where necessary.
Evaluate profitability (DuPont), liquidity, solvency, efficiency, and cash flows.
Translate Steps 1-3 into explicit assumptions; build linked 3-statement pro forma model.
Convert forecast into intrinsic value: DCF, Residual Income, and Multiples. Read the gap.
Translate valuation into a concrete recommendation for a specific stakeholder.

six_readers.question: Buy, hold, or sell? Is intrinsic value higher than the market price?
Will they repay? What is cash coverage, solvency, and collateral value?
Are they solvent, orderly, and compliant with accounting standards?
Is the mission financially sustainable over the long term?
Are resources being stewarded faithfully with minimal risk?
Were public funds used as appropriated according to law?

title: Refresher & Industry Strategy Analysis (Porter's Five Forces)
core_question: What is the source of competitive advantage, and can the industry sustain excess economic rents?
framework_details: Porter's Five Forces determines industry structure and profitability ceilings. Generic strategies: Cost Leadership vs Differentiation.

goto_five_forces.analysis: High capital barrier to build an ecosystem, but low switching costs allow niche fintechs or foreign giants (Bytedance/TikTok) to enter through partnerships.
Gig-economy drivers and merchants have multi-apping flexibility. Attempts to increase take-rates or cut driver incentives trigger strikes or churn.
Consumers experience near-zero switching costs between Grab, Gojek, Maxim, ShopeeFood, and InDrive. Habitual promo-seeking erodes pricing power.
Public transit (MRT, LRT, TransJakarta), offline dining, direct bank transfers (BI-FAST), and cash alternatives.
Duopoly competition against Grab in On-Demand Services (ODS) and against Sea Ltd (Shopee) / TikTok in e-commerce and fintech creates perpetual margin suppression.

goto_application.title: GoTo Strategy & Industry Economics (Milestone 1)
goto_application.strategy: Hybrid / Differentiation via Hyper-Local Ecosystem, but lacks Cost Leadership.
goto_application.verdict: Unfavorable industry economics prevent GoTo from achieving sustainable operating profits without continuous incentive cuts.

title: Asset/Liability Valuation & Income Recognition (PSAK/IFRS)
core_question: Recognition vs Measurement: How do accounting standards capture economic reality on the balance sheet?
framework_details: Three measurement bases: Historical Cost, Fair Value, and Net Realizable Value (ceiling). PSAK convergence with IFRS.

goto_application.title: GoTo Balance Sheet Accounting Reality (2025 Audited Balance Sheet)

items.name: Investment in Associates (Tokopedia & Bank Jago)
items.finding: GoTo owns 24.99% of PT Tokopedia and 21.4% of PT Bank Jago Tbk. Under equity method, only GoTo's net share of profits/losses appears on the income statement, obscuring Tokopedia's actual underlying cash burn from GoTo's top-line revenue.

items.name: Intangibles & Historical Goodwill
items.finding: Goodwill is never amortized: tested annually for impairment. GoTo previously took over Rp 70 trillion in goodwill impairments post-2021 merger, proving historical overpayment and balance sheet inflation.

items.name: Cash, Cash Equivalents & Time Deposits
items.finding: The single largest asset on GoTo's balance sheet. However, cash rose in 2025 not from operations (+Rp 307 bn), but from cashing in Rp 1.39T of time deposits and borrowing Rp 3.72T of new third-party bank debt.

study_takeaways: Recognition decides IF an asset appears on the balance sheet; Measurement decides AT WHAT NUMBER.
Historical cost provides verifiable conservatism; Fair value provides market relevance but introduces volatile mark-to-market swings.

title: Analyzing the Statement of Cash Flows
core_question: Direct vs Indirect Method: Is the business generating real cash from operations or living on external debt and asset liquidations?
framework_details: CFO + CFI + CFF = Net Change in Cash. Free Cash Flow = CFO - Capex. Free Cash Flow to Firm (FCFF) vs Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE).

goto_application.title: The 2025 Audited Cash Flow Reality (LK GOTO pp. 21-22)
goto_application.capex: Rp 1,182.4 billion (Rp 302.1 bn fixed assets + Rp 880.3 bn intangible software)
goto_application.financing_mask: Cash rose from Rp 21.00T to Rp 21.76T only because GoTo cashed in Rp 1,386.5 bn time deposits and borrowed Rp 3,718.0 bn of new debt (doubling debt to Rp 7,743 bn).

study_takeaways: CFO covered only 26.0% of Capex in 2025: core operations do not self-fund capital investment.
Operating cash flow was positive only due to working capital swings and deferred expenses, not underlying operating profitability.

title: Profitability Analysis I: Common-Size & DuPont ROE Framework
core_question: What is driving Return on Equity: Profit Margins, Asset Efficiency, or Financial Leverage?
framework_details: Vertical common-size (% of Revenue/Assets), Horizontal trend (% YoY), and 3-Step DuPont ROE = Net Margin x Asset Turnover x Equity Multiplier.

table.note: Huge operating expenses and restructuring costs; loss narrowed in 2025 to -Rp 1.50T.
Asset turnover improved as balance sheet contracted post-Tokopedia deconsolidation.
Leverage rose in 2025 as equity shrank (-19.6%) and total debt doubled.
Negative in every single year (vs Bukalapak +12.4% fueled by investment gains).

study_takeaways: ROE was negative across all 3 historical years due entirely to negative net profit margins.
Higher equity multiplier in 2025 indicates worsening financial leverage, not healthy capital expansion.

title: Profitability II & Solvency: Altman Z-Score Distress Analysis
core_question: Can the firm meet short-term obligations and survive long-term solvency distress?
framework_details: Current/Quick ratios, DSO/DIO/DPO cash conversion cycle, Debt/Equity, Interest Coverage, and Altman Z''-Score for Emerging Markets / Non-Manufacturers.
altman_formula: Z = 1.2X1 + 1.4X2 + 3.3X3 + 0.6X4 + X5 (Week 6 worksheet book-equity proxy for X4)

goto_application.title: Week 6 five-factor model
goto_application.takeaway: The completed Week 6 worksheet uses Z = 1.2X1 + 1.4X2 + 3.3X3 + 0.6X4 + X5, with book equity / total liabilities as its X4 proxy. FY2025 amounts in Rp million: working capital 18,411,702; assets 45,757,642; accumulated losses -215,334,000; EBIT -378,254; book equity 28,711,657; liabilities 17,045,985; revenue 18,322,117. Ratios X1-X5 = 0.402374, -4.705968, -0.008266, 1.684365, 0.400417. Weighted contributions = 0.482849, -6.588355, -0.027279, 1.010619, 0.400417. Z = -4.721750, rounded -4.72, below the course distress threshold of 1.81 (grey 1.81-2.99; safe above 2.99). Accumulated losses dominate the result. This screening signal does not establish imminent default. Source: Week 6 completed project and Milestone 2 Ratio Analysis C36.

study_takeaways: Interest coverage is -0.71x: operating income cannot cover Rp 535 bn annual interest expense.
Total debt doubled to Rp 7,743 bn in 2025, raising default risk if cash burn does not stop.

title: Accounting Quality & Earnings Management (Red Flags)
core_question: Are profits real economic earnings or accrual distortions, cookie-jar reserves, and aggressive capitalizations?
framework_details: Red flags: Divergence between Net Income and CFO, rising Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), sudden goodwill impairments, and related party disclosures.

flags.analysis: GoTo recognized large one-off non-cash accounting adjustments when transferring majority control of Tokopedia to ByteDance in early 2024, creating an artificial boost to reported 2024 earnings that does not repeat in 2025.

flags.flag: Consumer Lending Credit Loss Provisions Doubling
flags.analysis: Fintech loan impairment provisions more than doubled in 2025 to over Rp 1.4 trillion as GoTo aggressively grew GoPay Later buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) loans. Credit costs threaten to wipe out fintech revenue gains.

flags.flag: Aggressive Software Capitalization vs Operating Expense
flags.analysis: GoTo capitalized Rp 880.3 billion in intangible technology assets in 2025 instead of expensing it directly as R&D in opex, flattering operating income at the expense of heavy future amortization.

study_takeaways: Accrual quality is medium-low: reported Adjusted EBITDA excludes heavy stock-based compensation and depreciation costs.
Auditors placed Emphasis of Matter on ongoing restructuring and associate carrying values.

title: Analyzing Investing Activities & Intercorporate Investments
core_question: How are long-term assets and investments accounted for: PP&E, Goodwill, PSAK 15 (Equity Method) vs PSAK 65 (Consolidation)?
framework_details: Equity method (20-50% ownership) hides investee debt on a single line; Consolidation (>50%) includes 100% assets/debt with Non-Controlling Interest (NCI).

holdings.details: Controlled by ByteDance (TikTok Shop). GoTo does not consolidate Tokopedia's gross revenue or operating costs; instead, GoTo receives an e-commerce service fee (~Rp 150-200 bn/quarter) and records its 24.99% share of Tokopedia's net profit/loss.

holdings.entity: PT Bank Jago Tbk (Digital Banking Partner)
holdings.details: Strategic digital bank providing direct integration for GoPay savings accounts, term deposits, and consumer lending balance sheet funding.
Consists of Rp 302.1 bn physical fixed assets plus Rp 880.3 bn capitalized software and intangible development, consuming 3.8x GoTo's operating cash flow.

study_takeaways: Equity method keeps Tokopedia's ongoing operational volatility off GoTo's consolidated revenue and gross profit lines.
Carrying value of associates is vulnerable to future impairments if ByteDance/TikTok e-commerce growth slows.

title: Operating Activities: Revenue, Operating Leverage (DOL) & Segments
core_question: How do fixed vs variable costs determine operating leverage and segment profit contributions?
framework_details: Degree of Operating Leverage (DOL) = % Change in EBIT / % Change in Sales = Contribution Margin / EBIT. Point-in-time vs Over-time revenue recognition.

segments.name: On-Demand Services (ODS - Gojek)
segments.desc: Primary volume driver. Faces fierce price competition from Grab and Maxim, requiring ongoing driver and consumer incentives to protect market share.

segments.name: Financial Technology (Fintech - GoPay)
segments.desc: Highest growth potential in the group. Consumer loan book expansion provides lucrative interest margins, but requires heavy provisions for credit impairment.

segments.name: E-Commerce Service Fee (Tokopedia)
segments.desc: Contractual service fee paid by ByteDance for maintaining Tokopedia ecosystem integration, providing ~Rp 600-800 bn of annual pure cash margin.

goto_application.dol_analysis: Under GoTo's Base Case (where operating expenses scale at 78.5% of sales based on 3-year historical averages), Operating Income (EBIT) is negative in all forecast years (-Rp 4.0T in 2026F to -Rp 5.0T in 2028F). Because EBIT is negative, standard DOL is not reported / not meaningful. GoTo operates Below Breakeven, requiring Rp 27.2 trillion of revenue just to cover costs (vs forecast revenue of Rp 20.4 trillion).

study_takeaways: High fixed technology overhead creates extreme negative operating leverage when revenue growth decelerates.
Breakeven revenue required under Base Case costs is Rp 27.2 trillion (far above forecast revenue of Rp 20.4 trillion).

goto_application.reading_the_gap: DCF of -Rp121.1/share and residual income of -Rp75.1/share retain Assignment 14 and Milestone 4 assumptions. Negative model outputs signal failure of the projected cost structure to support equity value. They are not executable negative share prices. The Rp91.0 Grab benchmark reflects a different business valuation and does not resolve GoTo cash burn. Rp25 is the assignment reference price. Net cash of about Rp13.20/share is an arithmetic balance-sheet measure, not a guaranteed liquidation floor. The FY2025 peer comparison is retrospective because audited accounts were released after year-end.

study_takeaways: DCF and Residual Income converge on the exact same conclusion: GoTo destroys value under historical cost trends.
The market refuses to pay the peer multiple (2.10x P/B = Rp 56.8), treating GoTo as a distressed asset trading at 0.8x book value.
